description: This file defines the 'TodosScreen' widget, a stateful widget for displaying, filtering, refreshing, and managing a list of todo items within a Flutter application. It includes UI elements such as AppBar, ListView, and FloatingActionButton, and interacts with 'TodoProvider' for data operations.

classes.name: TodosScreen
classes.description: Main widget for displaying and managing the list of todos.

classes.name: _TodosScreenState
classes.description: State class for 'TodosScreen', handling UI state and interactions, including filtering, refreshing, and navigation.

classes.name: _LoadingState
classes.description: Stateless widget showing a loading indicator during data fetch.

classes.name: _EmptyState
classes.description: Stateless widget showing a message when no todos are present.

classes.name: _ErrorBar
classes.description: Widget displaying error messages related to todo operations.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the widget state, fetches todos asynchronously.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI for the Todos screen, including app bar, list, and actions.
